stories.title: Shiho Kuwaki Wins the AIG Women's Open in a Playoff at Royal Lytham (T1 — FRESH)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Shiho Kuwaki wins the AIG Women's Open at Royal Lytham.

Henseleit holed a 45-footer on 18 to force a playoff — then her tee shot hit a marshal on the 2nd hole.

Kuwaki made par. Title won.

Japan's 2nd straight AIG Women's Open champion. 🏆

#LPGA #AIGWomensOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Yealimi Noh led the AIG Women's Open entering the final round at -7.

Shiho Kuwaki won it at -5 in a playoff.

Haeran Ryu — who won the KPMG and Evian this year — finished T6 at -1.

Three different stories. One champion. 🏆

#LPGA #AIGWomensOpen

The Wyndham Championship starts Thursday at Sedgefield CC.

$8.5M. 500 FedExCup points. Last regular-season event.

Top 70 after Wyndham → Playoffs.

For the bubble players, every shot counts.

Aug 6-9. Greensboro, NC. ⛳

#PGATour #WyndhamChampionship

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Cameron Young defends at Wyndham — he won his first Tour title at Sedgefield in 2025.

Davis Riley just jumped into the top 70 after his Rocket Classic win.

Finau, Bradley, and Koepka still on the outside.

One week left. ⛳

#PGATour #WyndhamChampionship

stories.title: LIV Golf Crisis — WARN Act Filed, Team Championship in Jeopardy (T2 — DEVELOPING)

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf filed WARN Act notices in the U.S. and U.K. this month.

WARN Act = 60-day advance notice before mass layoffs.

PIF has delivered $200M of a $600M commitment. The $400M gap is real.

The Team Championship is "in serious jeopardy."

#LIVGolf

stories.title: Haeran Ryu — Grand Slam Bid Ends, But 2-Major Season Is Historic (T2 — RECAP)

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Haeran Ryu won the KPMG Women's PGA and the Evian Championship in 2026.

Back-to-back majors. Six weeks apart.

She then led the AIG Women's Open at halftime at Royal Lytham.

She finished T6 at -1.

Two majors in one year is still historic. ⛳

#LPGA
